question: What is the meaning of storage in relation to geographical properties?
description: Storage in relation to geographical properties refers to the organization and management of data related to the physical location or area. It involves storing information about spatial areas, structures, elements, and other geographical features in a systematic manner to facilitate effective data management and analysis.

Producers provide documentation to contractors. Possibility: arranging 
alignment with passports and management of source documentation. 
More information about centralised, decentralised and hybrid models 
can be found in in 7.2.3 ‘A centrally-decentrally controlled model’. 
Setting up a system for collective registration and management is an 
important future requirement. This is most likely to be a hybrid system 
with decentralised management of passport information. Such a system 
will have consequences for the government, i.e. additions to the 
cadastral registers, and market parties (registration and 
communication about continuity of information). The government's 
support is crucial here to enable the feasibility and scalability of 
passports, not only in financial terms, but also in order to safeguard 
uniform data collection methods.
